CustomField.description: Checked automatically when the consumption of this reading (its Value minus the Value of the previous reading of the meter) is more than 3 times the average consumption of the 3 previous readings of the same meter. Estimated readings are never flagged and never counted. Set by MeterReadingService, never typed.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Checked automatically when this reading's consumption is more than 3 times the average of the 3 previous consumptions of the meter. Check the reading before it is billed.
CustomField.label: Abnormal
